paper_memgpt_2023.name: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
paper_memgpt_2023.description: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI, but are constrained by limited context windows. We propose MemGPT (Memory-GPT), a system that man...
paper_memgpt_2023.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI, but are constrained by limited context windows. We propose MemGPT (Memory-GPT), a system that manages a memory hierarchy analogous to operating systems. MemGPT provides the illusion of infinite context through tiered memory paging between main context (working memory) and external context (archival and recall storage), controlled by self-directed function calls.

paper_self_refine_2023.name: Self-Refine: Iterative Reasoning with Feedback without Ground Truth
paper_self_refine_2023.description: Like humans, large language models (LLMs) rarely generate the optimal output on their first attempt. We present Self-Refine, an approach where an LLM ...
paper_self_refine_2023.abstract: Like humans, large language models (LLMs) rarely generate the optimal output on their first attempt. We present Self-Refine, an approach where an LLM iteratively refines its outputs using self-generated feedback stored in in-context working memory buffers without supervision or external training.

paper_recursive_summarization_2024.name: Walking Down the Memory Lane: Recursive Context Compression in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper_recursive_summarization_2024.description: Long-horizon agent tasks rapidly saturate context windows. We introduce Recursive Context Compression (RCC), an in-context working memory mechanism th...
paper_recursive_summarization_2024.abstract: Long-horizon agent tasks rapidly saturate context windows. We introduce Recursive Context Compression (RCC), an in-context working memory mechanism that summarizes older conversational rounds hierarchically while preserving recent turns verbatim, preventing context exhaustion.

paper_cot_memory_buffer_2023.name: Chain-of-Thought with Persistent Scratchpads: Stateful In-Context Reasoning for Multi-Step Tasks
paper_cot_memory_buffer_2023.description: Standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting fails when reasoning spans multiple decoupled interactions. We propose Stateful Scratchpad Buffers (SSB), ex...
paper_cot_memory_buffer_2023.abstract: Standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting fails when reasoning spans multiple decoupled interactions. We propose Stateful Scratchpad Buffers (SSB), externalizing intermediate reasoning traces into persistent working memory variables that persist across prompt boundaries.

paper_memetic_agent_2024.name: Memetic LLM Agents: Dynamic Working Memory Pruning via Utility Scoring
paper_memetic_agent_2024.description: We present Memetic Agent Memory, a selective context retention mechanism that calculates the utility score of prior interaction steps. Low-utility obs...
paper_memetic_agent_2024.abstract: We present Memetic Agent Memory, a selective context retention mechanism that calculates the utility score of prior interaction steps. Low-utility observations are dynamically evicted from working memory, leaving high-salience context intact.

paper_context_paging_letta_2024.name: Stateful Tool Management and Hierarchical Context Paging in Agent Runtimes
paper_context_paging_letta_2024.description: Extending operating-system inspired architectures, this work formalizes context paging protocols between LLM RAM (in-context window) and disk (relatio...
paper_context_paging_letta_2024.abstract: Extending operating-system inspired architectures, this work formalizes context paging protocols between LLM RAM (in-context window) and disk (relational database). We introduce atomic memory transactions to prevent state corruption during tool failures.

paper_sliding_window_attention_2023.name: StreamingLLM: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
paper_sliding_window_attention_2023.description: Serving LLM agents on infinite streams encounters two challenges: caching memory consumption and performance collapse when sequence length exceeds con...
paper_sliding_window_attention_2023.abstract: Serving LLM agents on infinite streams encounters two challenges: caching memory consumption and performance collapse when sequence length exceeds context limits. We discover attention sinks and propose StreamingLLM to maintain a persistent rolling working memory without fine-tuning.

paper_auto_compressor_2023.name: Adapting Language Models to Compress Contexts
paper_auto_compressor_2023.description: We explore AutoCompressor models that learn to compress long text sequences into compact summary tokens, which serve as an external memory vector in t...
paper_auto_compressor_2023.abstract: We explore AutoCompressor models that learn to compress long text sequences into compact summary tokens, which serve as an external memory vector in the working context window.

paper_dynamic_scratchpad_2024.name: Dynamic Working Memory Buffers for Multi-Agent Software Engineering
paper_dynamic_scratchpad_2024.description: In multi-agent software engineering, context windows easily saturate with stack traces and compiler outputs. We introduce Dynamic Working Buffers (DWB...
paper_dynamic_scratchpad_2024.abstract: In multi-agent software engineering, context windows easily saturate with stack traces and compiler outputs. We introduce Dynamic Working Buffers (DWB) that partition context into code view, execution trace, and active hypothesis memory.

paper_context_distillation_2023.name: In-Context Distillation for Long-Lived Dialogue Agents
paper_context_distillation_2023.description: We propose In-Context Distillation (ICD) to distill accumulated working memory traces into dense natural language persona and rule declarations, reset...
paper_context_distillation_2023.abstract: We propose In-Context Distillation (ICD) to distill accumulated working memory traces into dense natural language persona and rule declarations, resetting conversation token counters without behavioral drift.

paper_generative_agents_2023.name: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
paper_generative_agents_2023.description: We introduce generative agents—computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior. Generative agents store a comprehensive record o...
paper_generative_agents_2023.abstract: We introduce generative agents—computational software agents that simulate believable human behavior. Generative agents store a comprehensive record of the agent's experiences in a memory stream, synthesize memories over time into higher-level reflections, and retrieve them dynamically to plan actions.

paper_reflexion_2023.name: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
paper_reflexion_2023.description: Large language models increasingly execute tasks in interactive environments, but learning through trial and error remains challenging without fine-tu...
paper_reflexion_2023.abstract: Large language models increasingly execute tasks in interactive environments, but learning through trial and error remains challenging without fine-tuning. We propose Reflexion, an approach that endows agents with dynamic episodic memory of verbal self-reflection feedback to learn from failure.

paper_expel_2023.name: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experienced Learners
paper_expel_2023.description: Unlike reinforcement learning agents, LLM agents typically do not accumulate trial-and-error experiences across tasks. We propose ExpeL (Experienced L...
paper_expel_2023.abstract: Unlike reinforcement learning agents, LLM agents typically do not accumulate trial-and-error experiences across tasks. We propose ExpeL (Experienced Learner), which extracts parametric insights and experiential rule pools from past trajectories and stores them in cross-task episodic memory.

paper_retroformer_2023.name: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
paper_retroformer_2023.description: While Reflexion leverages heuristic verbal reflection, it lacks formal optimization over what reflections are beneficial. Retroformer introduces retro...
paper_retroformer_2023.abstract: While Reflexion leverages heuristic verbal reflection, it lacks formal optimization over what reflections are beneficial. Retroformer introduces retrospective verbal reinforcement learning by tuning the reflection generation policy using policy gradients based on downstream task success.

paper_agent_pro_2024.name: Agent-Pro: Truly Thinking and Acting like a Human with Dynamic Episodic Belief Revision
paper_agent_pro_2024.description: Interactive agents in non-stationary environments must continuously revise beliefs about their environment. Agent-Pro introduces dynamic episodic beli...
paper_agent_pro_2024.abstract: Interactive agents in non-stationary environments must continuously revise beliefs about their environment. Agent-Pro introduces dynamic episodic belief revision, where agents maintain historical hypothesis states and update them based on counter-evidence.

paper_memory_bank_2023.name: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
paper_memory_bank_2023.description: To establish long-term companionship and continuous assistance, LLMs need persistent memory that mimics human cognitive retention. We propose MemoryBa...
paper_memory_bank_2023.abstract: To establish long-term companionship and continuous assistance, LLMs need persistent memory that mimics human cognitive retention. We propose MemoryBank, a long-term memory system equipped with an Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve mechanism to manage memory strength over time.

paper_clinx_experience_2024.name: ClinX: Clinical Trial Episode Memory for Multi-Year Medical Agent Alignment
paper_clinx_experience_2024.description: We evaluate episodic patient trajectory memory in healthcare LLMs. ClinX structures clinical episodes into diagnostic hypotheses, interventions, and m...
paper_clinx_experience_2024.abstract: We evaluate episodic patient trajectory memory in healthcare LLMs. ClinX structures clinical episodes into diagnostic hypotheses, interventions, and multi-month clinical outcomes, retrieving prior matching trajectories to guide new patient triage.

paper_remind_experience_2023.name: REMIND: Retrieval-Augmented Experience Replay for Continual LLM Agents
paper_remind_experience_2023.description: Continual learning in language agents suffers from catastrophic forgetting. REMIND implements experience replay by storing trajectory tuples and retri...
paper_remind_experience_2023.abstract: Continual learning in language agents suffers from catastrophic forgetting. REMIND implements experience replay by storing trajectory tuples and retrieving diverse contrastive pairs during reflection phases.

paper_traj_bank_2024.name: TrajectoryBank: Large-Scale Trajectory Memory for Web Navigation Agents
paper_traj_bank_2024.description: Web agents repeatedly fail on complex multi-step navigation. TrajectoryBank aggregates thousands of historical browser action traces, indexing DOM sta...
paper_traj_bank_2024.abstract: Web agents repeatedly fail on complex multi-step navigation. TrajectoryBank aggregates thousands of historical browser action traces, indexing DOM states, user intents, and action sequences into an episodic lookup memory.

paper_synapse_memory_2024.name: Synapse: Trajectory-as-Exemplar Memory for Generalist Computer Agents
paper_synapse_memory_2024.description: We introduce Synapse, an exemplar memory architecture that converts past task trajectories into modular prompt exemplars, enabling zero-shot agents to...
paper_synapse_memory_2024.abstract: We introduce Synapse, an exemplar memory architecture that converts past task trajectories into modular prompt exemplars, enabling zero-shot agents to adapt to novel operating system tasks.

paper_voyager_2023.name: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
paper_voyager_2023.description: We introduce Voyager, the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft. Voyager continually explores the world, develops increasing...
paper_voyager_2023.abstract: We introduce Voyager, the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft. Voyager continually explores the world, develops increasingly sophisticated skills, and makes discoveries without human intervention. Voyager consists of three key components: an automatic curriculum, an iterative prompting mechanism, and a skill library for storing executable code skills.

paper_gitm_2023.name: Ghost in the Minecraft: Generally Capable Agents with Large Language Models via Structured Action Memory
paper_gitm_2023.description: We present GITM (Ghost in the Minecraft), an agent framework using structured action memory trees to solve complex open-ended tasks in Minecraft, achi...
paper_gitm_2023.abstract: We present GITM (Ghost in the Minecraft), an agent framework using structured action memory trees to solve complex open-ended tasks in Minecraft, achieving 100% success rate on the ObtainDiamond task.

paper_cradle_2024.name: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control
paper_cradle_2024.description: Cradle is a general computer control framework enabling agents to interact with arbitrary software via screen inputs and keyboard/mouse actions. It ut...
paper_cradle_2024.abstract: Cradle is a general computer control framework enabling agents to interact with arbitrary software via screen inputs and keyboard/mouse actions. It utilizes a multimodal procedural memory that indexes visual application workflows.

paper_toolkenizer_2024.name: Toolkenizer: Tokens That Are Tools for Continuous Skill Invocation
paper_toolkenizer_2024.description: Rather than treating tools as external API text calls, Toolkenizer maps each tool into a discrete procedural token embedding, integrating procedural m...
paper_toolkenizer_2024.abstract: Rather than treating tools as external API text calls, Toolkenizer maps each tool into a discrete procedural token embedding, integrating procedural memory directly into the language model vocabulary.

paper_toolllm_2023.name: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16,000+ Real-World APIs
paper_toolllm_2023.description: We construct ToolBench, an instruction-tuning dataset for tool use, and develop ToolLLM. We propose ToolIR, a procedural tool memory retrieval system ...
paper_toolllm_2023.abstract: We construct ToolBench, an instruction-tuning dataset for tool use, and develop ToolLLM. We propose ToolIR, a procedural tool memory retrieval system that indexes OpenAPI documentation for multi-step reasoning.

paper_skillnet_2024.name: SkillNet: Procedural Skill Graph Consolidation for Lifelong Robotic Agents
paper_skillnet_2024.description: Robotic agents accumulate execution scripts that become redundant. SkillNet builds a directed procedural graph where nodes represent parameterized ski...
paper_skillnet_2024.abstract: Robotic agents accumulate execution scripts that become redundant. SkillNet builds a directed procedural graph where nodes represent parameterized skills and edges represent compositional pre-conditions and post-conditions.

paper_progprompt_2023.name: ProgPrompt: Generating Situated Robot Task Plans using Large Language Models
paper_progprompt_2023.description: ProgPrompt proposes a programmatic procedural memory where plans are generated as Pythonic programs with assertions and error-handling routines ground...
paper_progprompt_2023.abstract: ProgPrompt proposes a programmatic procedural memory where plans are generated as Pythonic programs with assertions and error-handling routines grounded in real-time scene perception.

paper_saycan_2022.name: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
paper_saycan_2022.description: We show how language model planning can be grounded in physical affordances by combining LLM semantic probabilities with value functions of learned pr...
paper_saycan_2022.abstract: We show how language model planning can be grounded in physical affordances by combining LLM semantic probabilities with value functions of learned procedural skills.

paper_robollm_memory_2024.name: RoboMemory: Hierarchical Skill Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Mobile Manipulation
paper_robollm_memory_2024.description: We present RoboMemory, decoupling long-horizon robotic plans into spatial navigation skills and precision manipulation skills, maintained in a structu...
paper_robollm_memory_2024.abstract: We present RoboMemory, decoupling long-horizon robotic plans into spatial navigation skills and precision manipulation skills, maintained in a structured procedural hierarchy.

paper_code_as_policies_2022.name: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
paper_code_as_policies_2022.description: We show that language models can be prompted to write robot policy code as procedural memory, using Python logic to express loops, conditionals, and g...
paper_code_as_policies_2022.abstract: We show that language models can be prompted to write robot policy code as procedural memory, using Python logic to express loops, conditionals, and geometric calculations.

paper_hipporag_2024.name: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
paper_hipporag_2024.description: Human long-term memory relies on the hippocampal-cortical system to achieve continuous integration and associative recall. We present HippoRAG, a nove...
paper_hipporag_2024.abstract: Human long-term memory relies on the hippocampal-cortical system to achieve continuous integration and associative recall. We present HippoRAG, a novel retrieval framework inspired by hippocampal indexing theory. HippoRAG converts passages into an open-domain knowledge graph and utilizes Personalized PageRank (PPR) over the graph to perform multi-hop associative recall.

paper_mem0_2024.name: Mem0: The Memory Layer for Personalized AI Applications
paper_mem0_2024.description: We present Mem0, a scalable, production-grade memory layer for AI agents. Mem0 maintains an external key-value and vector memory store that automatica...
paper_mem0_2024.abstract: We present Mem0, a scalable, production-grade memory layer for AI agents. Mem0 maintains an external key-value and vector memory store that automatically extracts user facts, updates preferences over time, and resolves conflicting statements via memory consolidation.

paper_think_in_memory_2023.name: TiM: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-Thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
paper_think_in_memory_2023.description: We propose Think-in-Memory (TiM), a framework that enables LLMs to maintain long-term memory through a two-stage process: Pre-thinking for recalling r...
paper_think_in_memory_2023.abstract: We propose Think-in-Memory (TiM), a framework that enables LLMs to maintain long-term memory through a two-stage process: Pre-thinking for recalling relevant memories before responding, and Post-thinking for consolidating and updating memory after interaction.

paper_memochat_2023.name: MemoChat: Tuning LLMs to Use Memos for Consistent Long-Range Open-Domain Conversation
paper_memochat_2023.description: Maintaining consistency in long-range open-domain dialogue requires recording key facts without cluttering context. MemoChat instructs LLMs to write s...
paper_memochat_2023.abstract: Maintaining consistency in long-range open-domain dialogue requires recording key facts without cluttering context. MemoChat instructs LLMs to write structured memos and retrieve them through targeted queries.

paper_memwalker_2023.name: Memory-Augmented Language Models through Tree-Structured Memory (MemWalker)
paper_memwalker_2023.description: Dense retrieval often struggles to locate relevant needles in vast textual haystacks. MemWalker reads long documents by structuring text into a summar...
paper_memwalker_2023.abstract: Dense retrieval often struggles to locate relevant needles in vast textual haystacks. MemWalker reads long documents by structuring text into a summary tree, allowing the agent to navigate the tree iteratively to pinpoint target passages.

paper_dense_retrieval_memory_2023.name: Dense Retrieval for Agent Memory: Benchmarking Vector Stores under Realistic Query Drift
paper_dense_retrieval_memory_2023.description: We evaluate traditional dense embedding retrieval (Dense Passage Retrieval, Contriever) when used as external agent memory under realistic conversatio...
paper_dense_retrieval_memory_2023.abstract: We evaluate traditional dense embedding retrieval (Dense Passage Retrieval, Contriever) when used as external agent memory under realistic conversational drift and synonym variation.

paper_rag_survey_memory_2023.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey of Memory Architectures
paper_rag_survey_memory_2023.description: This survey analyzes the paradigm shift from static RAG to dynamic agent memory. We categorize retrieval mechanisms into pre-retrieval, iterative retr...
paper_rag_survey_memory_2023.abstract: This survey analyzes the paradigm shift from static RAG to dynamic agent memory. We categorize retrieval mechanisms into pre-retrieval, iterative retrieval, and adaptive retrieval, mapping their role in agent architectures.

paper_c-rag_2024.name: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG)
paper_c-rag_2024.description: We design CRAG to improve the robustness of external retrieval memory. CRAG employs a retrieval evaluator to assess the quality of retrieved documents...
paper_c-rag_2024.abstract: We design CRAG to improve the robustness of external retrieval memory. CRAG employs a retrieval evaluator to assess the quality of retrieved documents, triggering web search fallback when internal retrieval confidence is low.

paper_active_rag_2023.name: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation (FLARE)
paper_active_rag_2023.description: Existing RAG systems retrieve memory passively at the start of generation. We propose Forward-Looking Active REtrieval (FLARE), which monitors generat...
paper_active_rag_2023.abstract: Existing RAG systems retrieve memory passively at the start of generation. We propose Forward-Looking Active REtrieval (FLARE), which monitors generation confidence and triggers external memory retrieval dynamically when predicting low-probability tokens.

paper_self_rag_2023.name: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
paper_self_rag_2023.description: We introduce Self-RAG, an end-to-end framework that trains a model to dynamically retrieve external memory on-demand and evaluate the retrieved passag...
paper_self_rag_2023.abstract: We introduce Self-RAG, an end-to-end framework that trains a model to dynamically retrieve external memory on-demand and evaluate the retrieved passages using special reflection tokens.

paper_kg_agent_2024.name: KG-Agent: An Efficient Autonomous Agent Framework Powered by Knowledge Graph Memory
paper_kg_agent_2024.description: Unstructured text memory leads to hallucinations and fuzzy associative retrieval. We propose KG-Agent, an autonomous agent framework that maintains an...
paper_kg_agent_2024.abstract: Unstructured text memory leads to hallucinations and fuzzy associative retrieval. We propose KG-Agent, an autonomous agent framework that maintains an evolving knowledge graph as its core memory backbone. By representing facts as explicit (entity, relation, entity) triplets, KG-Agent enables rigorous multi-hop relational reasoning and precise memory updating.

paper_graph_of_thought_2023.name: Graph of Thoughts: Solving Elaborate Problems with Large Language Models
paper_graph_of_thought_2023.description: We introduce Graph of Thoughts (GoT), which models LLM reasoning as an arbitrary directed graph where thoughts are vertices and dependencies are edges...
paper_graph_of_thought_2023.abstract: We introduce Graph of Thoughts (GoT), which models LLM reasoning as an arbitrary directed graph where thoughts are vertices and dependencies are edges. This enables combining, aggregating, and looping over distinct reasoning memory paths.

paper_memgraph_2024.name: MemGraph: Dynamic Knowledge Graph Memory with Temporal Edge Invalidation
paper_memgraph_2024.description: Real-world agent environments change over time, rendering older facts untrue. MemGraph introduces temporal knowledge graph memory where edges possess ...
paper_memgraph_2024.abstract: Real-world agent environments change over time, rendering older facts untrue. MemGraph introduces temporal knowledge graph memory where edges possess valid time intervals, automatically expiring stale relational connections.

paper_mindmap_2023.name: MindMap: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Hop Medical Diagnostic Agents
paper_mindmap_2023.description: Medical agents must ground decisions in verified clinical knowledge. MindMap constructs a dynamic patient-specific graph memory linked to external med...
paper_mindmap_2023.abstract: Medical agents must ground decisions in verified clinical knowledge. MindMap constructs a dynamic patient-specific graph memory linked to external medical knowledge ontologies (UMLS), guiding diagnostic reasoning along validated clinical paths.

paper_socratic_memory_2024.name: Socratic Graph Memory: Dialectical Reasoning via Concept Graph Traversal in Autonomous Agents
paper_socratic_memory_2024.description: We present Socratic Graph Memory, an architecture that structures memory into thesis, antithesis, and synthesis nodes. The agent traverses counter-arg...
paper_socratic_memory_2024.abstract: We present Socratic Graph Memory, an architecture that structures memory into thesis, antithesis, and synthesis nodes. The agent traverses counter-arguments before finalizing execution plans.

paper_tree_of_thought_2023.name: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
paper_tree_of_thought_2023.description: We introduce Tree of Thoughts (ToT), enabling exploration over coherent units of text (thoughts) that serve as intermediate steps toward problem solvi...
paper_tree_of_thought_2023.abstract: We introduce Tree of Thoughts (ToT), enabling exploration over coherent units of text (thoughts) that serve as intermediate steps toward problem solving. ToT maintains a tree memory where search algorithms (BFS/DFS) explore and backtrack.

paper_graph_rag_2024.name: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
paper_graph_rag_2024.description: We present GraphRAG, combining LLM-extracted knowledge graphs with community detection algorithms (Leiden) to generate hierarchical community summarie...
paper_graph_rag_2024.abstract: We present GraphRAG, combining LLM-extracted knowledge graphs with community detection algorithms (Leiden) to generate hierarchical community summaries, allowing agents to reason over global corpus structures.

paper_hypergraph_memory_2024.name: HyperGraph Memory: Modeling Higher-Order Interactions in Multi-Agent Collaborative Systems
paper_hypergraph_memory_2024.description: Standard graphs only capture pairwise relations. We propose HyperGraph Memory, where hyperedges connect arbitrary numbers of agent actions, environmen...
paper_hypergraph_memory_2024.abstract: Standard graphs only capture pairwise relations. We propose HyperGraph Memory, where hyperedges connect arbitrary numbers of agent actions, environmental states, and outcomes simultaneously.

paper_relational_sketchpad_2023.name: Relational Scratchpads: Enhancing LLM Reasoning via Dynamic Graph Memory Tables
paper_relational_sketchpad_2023.description: We propose Relational Scratchpads, structuring intermediate scratchpad memory into dynamic tabular graphs with explicit foreign-key linkages between e...
paper_relational_sketchpad_2023.abstract: We propose Relational Scratchpads, structuring intermediate scratchpad memory into dynamic tabular graphs with explicit foreign-key linkages between entities.

paper_agent_kg_lifecycle_2024.name: Knowledge Graph Memory Lifecycle in Continual Learning Agents
paper_agent_kg_lifecycle_2024.description: We analyze the lifecycle of graph memory in lifelong agents, proposing a unified formalization of node birth, edge reinforcement, edge decay, and grap...
paper_agent_kg_lifecycle_2024.abstract: We analyze the lifecycle of graph memory in lifelong agents, proposing a unified formalization of node birth, edge reinforcement, edge decay, and graph consolidation.

paper_alfworld_2021.name: ALFWorld: Aligning Text and Embodied Environments for Interactive Learning
paper_alfworld_2021.description: We present ALFWorld, a benchmark of interactive text environments aligned with physical embodied worlds (ALFRED). ALFWorld evaluates how agents reason...
paper_alfworld_2021.abstract: We present ALFWorld, a benchmark of interactive text environments aligned with physical embodied worlds (ALFRED). ALFWorld evaluates how agents reason, plan, and remember object locations and spatial relationships across multi-step household tasks.

paper_webarena_2023.name: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
paper_webarena_2023.description: We introduce WebArena, an end-to-end web environment designed for building and evaluating autonomous agents. WebArena hosts fully functional standalon...
paper_webarena_2023.abstract: We introduce WebArena, an end-to-end web environment designed for building and evaluating autonomous agents. WebArena hosts fully functional standalone websites (e-commerce, social forum, collaborative code repository, content management system) to benchmark long-horizon interactive tasks requiring memory.

paper_gaia_2023.name: GAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants
paper_gaia_2023.description: We propose GAIA (General AI Assistant), a benchmark designed to evaluate generalist AI assistants on multi-modal, long-horizon tasks requiring complex...
paper_gaia_2023.abstract: We propose GAIA (General AI Assistant), a benchmark designed to evaluate generalist AI assistants on multi-modal, long-horizon tasks requiring complex reasoning, tool use, and multi-modal memory integration. Questions are conceptually easy for humans but difficult for AI.

paper_agentbench_2023.name: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
paper_agentbench_2023.description: We present AgentBench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs as autonomous agents across 8 distinct environments including opera...
paper_agentbench_2023.abstract: We present AgentBench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs as autonomous agents across 8 distinct environments including operating systems, databases, web browsing, and digital games.

paper_lost_in_middle_2023.name: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
paper_lost_in_middle_2023.description: While language models advertise context windows of 32k+ tokens, we discover that model performance degrades significantly when key information is loca...
paper_lost_in_middle_2023.abstract: While language models advertise context windows of 32k+ tokens, we discover that model performance degrades significantly when key information is located in the middle of long input contexts, exhibiting a U-shaped performance curve.

paper_memory_drift_study_2024.name: Memory Drift and Hallucination Accumulation in Long-Horizon Autonomous Agents
paper_memory_drift_study_2024.description: We empirically study failure modes in agent episodic memory over 100+ turn interactions. We identify memory drift: the gradual distortion of factual t...
paper_memory_drift_study_2024.abstract: We empirically study failure modes in agent episodic memory over 100+ turn interactions. We identify memory drift: the gradual distortion of factual truth as agents summarize and re-summarize past events.

paper_retrieval_distraction_2024.name: Retrieval Distraction: When External Memory Hurts Agent Decision Making
paper_retrieval_distraction_2024.description: External memory retrieval is assumed to universally help agents. We prove that irrelevant or marginally relevant retrieved memories distract LLM reaso...
paper_retrieval_distraction_2024.abstract: External memory retrieval is assumed to universally help agents. We prove that irrelevant or marginally relevant retrieved memories distract LLM reasoning, decreasing task success by up to 28% compared to no memory.

paper_hotpotqa_2018.name: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
paper_hotpotqa_2018.description: We present HotpotQA, a new dataset with 113k Wikipedia-based question-answer pairs that require reading and reasoning over multiple supporting documen...
paper_hotpotqa_2018.abstract: We present HotpotQA, a new dataset with 113k Wikipedia-based question-answer pairs that require reading and reasoning over multiple supporting documents, serving as a primary benchmark for agent multi-hop memory retrieval.

paper_mind2web_2023.name: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
paper_mind2web_2023.description: We introduce Mind2Web, the first dataset for developing and evaluating generalist web agents across 137 real-world websites, covering 2,000 tasks and ...
paper_mind2web_2023.abstract: We introduce Mind2Web, the first dataset for developing and evaluating generalist web agents across 137 real-world websites, covering 2,000 tasks and testing procedural memory for web interaction.

paper_memory_safety_2024.name: Security and Privacy Vulnerabilities in Agentic Memory Systems: Prompt Injections through Persistent Storage
paper_memory_safety_2024.description: We reveal a critical vulnerability in autonomous agents with persistent memory: Indirect Prompt Injection via Memory Pollution. Malicious external con...
paper_memory_safety_2024.abstract: We reveal a critical vulnerability in autonomous agents with persistent memory: Indirect Prompt Injection via Memory Pollution. Malicious external content stored into episodic memory executes when later retrieved.

paper_react_2022.name: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
paper_react_2022.description: We explore using LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. ReAct maintains an in-context action-obser...
paper_react_2022.abstract: We explore using LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. ReAct maintains an in-context action-observation working memory buffer that logs intermediate thought-action-observation cycles.

paper_lats_2024.name: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
paper_lats_2024.description: We present Language Agent Tree Search (LATS), an agent framework that incorporates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with reflective episodic memory to e...
paper_lats_2024.abstract: We present Language Agent Tree Search (LATS), an agent framework that incorporates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with reflective episodic memory to enable deliberate planning and backtracking across decision branches.

paper_inner_monologue_2022.name: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
paper_inner_monologue_2022.description: We demonstrate that embodied agents can reason over physical world interactions by injecting continuous perception feedback into an in-context inner m...

limit_memory_drift.description: Progressive distortion of factual truth across recursive summarization and re-indexing cycles.

limit_skill_proliferation.description: Uncontrolled accumulation of near-duplicate micro-skills degrading retrieval precision and execution speed.

limit_inference_latency.description: Prohibitive token consumption and latency caused by multi-round reflection cycles or tree rollouts.

limit_prompt_injection.description: Storage of adversarial instructions into long-term memory that hijack future agent operations.
